arguments.sql:
SELECT ml.city, ml.state, COUNT(*) AS fraud_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
JOIN merchant_locations ml ON ml.id = t.merchant_location_id
WHERE f.is_fraud = 1 AND ml.city <> 'ONLINE'
GROUP BY ml.city, ml.state
ORDER BY fraud_count DESC, ml.city, ml.state
arguments.explanation: Counts the fraud-labelled transactions for each city and state, most frequent first. Online transactions are left out because they have no city.
assumptions: Fraud means fraud_labels.is_fraud = 1; only labelled transactions are counted.
Online transactions (city 'ONLINE', no state) are excluded because they have no physical city; they are not included in the city counts.
The city is taken from the transaction's merchant location (transactions.merchant_location_id), and the state is shown alongside it because city names can repeat across states.
The full data range (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31) is used, since no period was specified.
